headline: SBV Approves ABBank Charter Capital Increase to VND 26,833 Billion
summary: An Binh Commercial Joint Stock Bank received approval from the State Bank of Vietnam to raise charter capital by up to VND 10,765 billion. The increase will use public share offering, bonus shares and ESOP shares.
why: Charter capital increases strengthen a bank's capital base, which supports lending capacity and regulatory ratios. ABBank is a Vietnamese commercial bank listed on UPCoM.
